summary:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a storytelling project set on the Moon and Mars. We developed a visual story using characters, creative scenes and explanations to show abandoned objects in space. This project addresses the challenge by highlighting the history and importance of objects left behind on the Moon and Mars. It helps viewers understand that these objects still have value even when they are no longer used.
This project is important because it encourages people to appreciate space history, protect historical objects and understand the value of things that are often forgotten.
details: Our project, titled "A Storytelling Journey About NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars," is an educational digital comic book featuring three friends, Aiman, Bella and Daniel, together with their robot, Chiko. They explore the Moon and Mars to discover abandoned NASA equipment and learn interesting facts about space.This project aims to educate children and teenagers about space exploration in a fun and creative way. It helps readers gain knowledge, develop curiosity and increase their interest in science and astronomy.We used Canva and AI tools to design cartoon characters, create comic illustrations and develop our digital storytelling content. Our creativity is shown through colourful visuals, interesting characters and an engaging storyline.Our team considered educational value, creativity, simple language and attractive illustrations to make the comic enjoyable and easy to understand for all generations.
